findings.governingReading: There is no time like the present for doing good
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-heroic proverb disappears from the comic plan to save Issei from Rin.
Shirou’s teasing description of Rin as eager and impetuous becomes a categorical judgment that she is violent.

findings.highlight: before her relationship with Issei becomes a terrible one
findings.evidenceJa: 仲が修復不可能になる前に
findings.governingReading: before her relationship with Issei becomes impossible to repair
findings.explanation: Permanent relational damage is weakened into a generically bad relationship.

findings.governingReading: there was no Command Spell anywhere on his body
findings.explanation: The extent of Shirou’s physical inspection, which supplies the scene’s joke and his certainty, is omitted.
